sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Cracking in cervical vertebrae when mov-
ing the head. Pain on top as from a nail. Pressure on
vertex, in morning ; worse till noon and in warm room.
Stitches. Objects appear too large. Migraine; first on
left side. Twitching of upper lip.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Violent sneezing; stopped up. Nasal
catarrh, with redness and swelling at tip of nose. Acute
pain at root of nose, extending to vertex and through
temples.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Sore, right side with great tenderness;
soreness to touch externally. Strangulated feeling.

Gastric. — Gone, empty feeling in epigastrium,
without desire for food. Acute gastralgia with pains
extending to shoulder. Thirst and intense hiccough.
Sour, fetid secretions ooze from molar teeth. Diar-
rhoea and tenesmus after milk.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses late, scanty, with great debility
and burning in eyes. Profuse lencorrhoea; worse, after
urinating [Mag. mur.; Plat.] ; also worse after menses.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Hoarseness. Dry, hacking cough,
with stitches in chest. Obliged to sit up and hold head.
Must put arms on thighs, when coughing.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching all over, worse on neck, not relieved
by scratching.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, periodically, every two weeks ;
yearly, forenoon. Better, in evening.

sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Emotional. Very angry and quarrelsome mood ; she was
inclined to quarrel with and contradict every one, in the evening (second
day)/. — Quarrelsome and impatient ; she could tolerate no contradiction ;
only better towards evening (third to sixth day),\ — Very anxious on every
movement, as if sweat would break out (fourth and fifth days),*. — Very
anxious, with excessive thirst day and night (first and second days),*. —
Apprehensive, despondent; she does not even know herself what is the
matter, in the afternoon (second day),*. — Apprehensive and despondent, as
if some misfortune were impending (second day),*. — Lachrymose and ap-
prehensive (second day),*. — She was very apprehensive and lachrymose in
the forenoon (first day) ; on the second and third days she was very fretful,
and was better only on the fifth day,*. — ^Tremulous, fearful, with inclination
to be alone all day (after three days),*. — [10.] No inclination to talk, and
when compelled to do so he is very fretful (third day),*. — ^No inclination
to talk, and very fretful humor (fourth day),*. — Constant good and joyous
mood ; all passions are quiet,*.

Heetd. — Confusion and Tertii/o. Dull and confused in the
head, as after intoxication, in the morning (sixth day),*.— Vertigo all day.

— Boreheadm [40.] A whirling in the foreheaa, as if she would be sick

ear, with ten^ pains only on preswire (sixteenth day),*.— A Ukter as

Ifose . — Violent bleeding of the nose for over an hour (first day),*. —
Frequent violent sneezing for several days, in the forenoon,*. — Sneezing

ing without coryza, several mornings in succession, through the first part

enth day),*. — Dr}’ness of the nose, without stoppage of it (sixth and seventh

coryza (second and third days),*. — Nose at one time stopped, at another
open, though without sensation of coryza (third day),*. — Stoppage of the
nose at night ; she could get no air through it (after ten days),*. — Although

Foee * — Sensation as if the face were swollen ; it seems heavy, with
some lachrymation (ninth day),*. — [110.] Swelling of the right side of the

bum while eating (fourteenth day),*. — A broad stripe in the red margin of

swelling of the gum, which was aggravated by pressure and by the air,*. —
Tearing in the right lower jaw, in the evening, at night, and even on the
following day,*.

teenth day),*. — Painful boring and gnawing in a right lower molar, disap-

&nawing sensation in a right lower molar, from which a sourish oTOOsive

— Disgusting taste and odor in the mouth (second day),'. — Disagree-

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Sore throat, three evenings in succession, on talking and
yawning, but not on swallowing, lasting till the next morning (after seven-
teen days),'. — The whole throat seems ulcerated internally, especially on
swallowing ; with yawning and shaking chill, in the morning (fifth day),'.
— The sore throat that had lasted for some days became worse and very
sensitive to touch on the right side; also the right tonsil was swollen, with
inflammation of the right side of the throat internally (ninth day),'. —
Pain in the throat from eveuiug till the next forenoon, near noon, some-
times only on yawning and talking, at other times also on swallowing
(twenty-fourth day),'. — Sticking in the throat ; he dreaded to swallow on
account of the violent pain in the right side, in the morning (fourth day),'.
— Sticking in the throat, as if in the uvula, only on swallowing (first and
second days),'. — Rawness in the throat all day (second day),'. — Rawness
in the throat, relieved by cough (second day),'. — [150.] Feeling of con-
striction in the throat, so that he gasped for air, in the afternoon and night
(first day),'. — Spasmodic choking and constriction in the throat and stick-
ing on swallowing (third day),'. — ^Tickling in the throat causing a dry
hacking cough, in the evening (fifth day),*. — Tickling in the throat that
provokes cough, in the evening after lying down, though soon disappearing
(fifth day),'. — Thick mucus coustautly collects in the throat, with stinging
pain (fourth day),'. — Sensation of heartburn io the throat, iu the eveuiug and
night (twelfth day),'. — The thyroid gland was very sensitive to pressure,
with a sensation on swallowing as if there were a membrane across the
throat (eleventh day),‘.

She had no desire for anything; she tried to think of what
she wanted (fourth to sixth day),*. — ^Thirst all day (first day),'.— Great

eeeeral esenings^K — Freouent violent hioeougb, in the evening, renewM from

Profuse emission of odorless flatus, the whole afternoon (sixth dayy.—

den griping in the right groin a few times, on stretching out the body,

— A sudden very violent cutting pain in the abdomen, immediately fol-

Constipation (first, second, third, and thirteenth days),*.— Stool very hard
(first aay),*.-^tool very hard, only evacuated with great exertion ; only

Urinary Organs* — Increased micturition, in the morning (fifth
day),*. — Urine passed frequently and profusely though she drank but

Sexual Organs* — Male. Itching in a small spot on the scrotum
for half an hour, not relieved by scratching (fifth day)/. — Erections after

relieved after rubbing (ninth day),*. — Menses three days too early,*. —

Menses five days too early, with pain in the abdomen and small of the
back,*. — Menstruation that had already stopped for one day reappeared
profusely, again disappeared the following day ; after a new dose it again

nine days too late,*. — Leucorrhoea (sixteenth day),*. — Profuse leucorrhcea
(second and third days)/. — Very watery leucorrhoea, especially after urin-
ating (sixth day),*.

Mespiratory Organs. — Larynx. Hoarseness, in the evening of
sixteenth day and morning of seventeenth day,*. — [270.] Hoarseness, so
that he could scarcely talk (first day)/. — Cough. Cough dry, bat infre-
auent, day and night, caused by tickling in the trachea (third and fourth
days),*. — Violent cough at night, so that he was obliged to sit up and hold
the head (fourth day),*. — Cough from time to time, even at night (after
thirteen days),*. — Some paroxysms of cough, from time to time, though
without expectoration, for several days,*. — Some violent paroxysms'bf cough
with some expectorations of mucus (fifth day),*. — Respiration. Very
short breath, when at work while sitting ; it disappears on walking (fourth

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Pressure upon the chest, with rather heavy respiration, and
frequent hacking cough all day (twenty-sixth day),*. — Pressure in the
chest, from 2 p.m. till evening, and a feeling of internal soreness,*. — Fre-
quent distressing though very transient heaviness in the chest, in the after-
noon,*. — [280.] Painfulness within the chest, iq the afternoon (sixth day),*.

— ^The chest seems cut to pieces and sore, in the afternoon ; recurring for
two evenings ; following this pain, itching in the same place, that only
disappears after violent scratching (after eleven days),*. — Pain in the chest as
if sore, without cough, and without effect upon the respiration, in the after-
noon (ninth day),*. — ^re pain in the chest/. — Violent stitches in the chest,
especially on becoming erect (first and second days),*. — Sharp stitches in
the sternum, in the at'ternoon while idtting, lasting till evening (eleventh
day),*. — Many burning needle-like stitches in the middle of the sternum
(third day)/. — Sharp Pitches with tenmon in the right ude of the chest,
in the afternoon (second day),*. — Some sharp stitches in the right side of

641

the chest on raising the arm (twenty-fourth day),*. — Some violent stitches
externally on the right lower ribs {after two hours ,*.—[290.] Twitching
in the right lower costal region on raising the arm, in the evening (third
. day),*.— Stitches below the right axilla, while laughing (fifteenth day),*. —
Small intermitting stitches, as with an awl, in the right side of the chest
(fourteenth day),*. — A very violent stitch beneath the right breast (tenth
day),*. — Stitches in a spot as broad as the hand, in the left side of the
chest, esj^ecialiy violent alter rising from stooping, in the afternoon (second
day),*. — Burning in the left side of the chest, posteriorly on raising the
arm (the thirteenth day),*. — Burning in the left side of the chest, on the
ribs, at 1 p.m. (third day),*. — Fine stitches extending into the left breast
(twelfth day),*. — Violent stitch, extending deep inward beneath the left
breast, taking away her breath (tenth day),*. — Violent stitches in the left
side of the chest causing to start, with burning on raising the arm (first
day),*. — [300.] Violent sticking in the left side of the chest while laugh-
ing ; she could not laugh cn accoiint of the pain (after twenty-four days),*.
— N^iolcnt stitches in the left chest while walking, aggravated by inspira-
tion, in the afternoon (twenty-fourth day),*. — Fine sticking in the leftside
of the chest externally, as if in the fiesh (third day),*.

Nevh and Sock . — ^Fain as from a sprain, in the nape of the neck ;
on becoming erect after stooping, with cracking, lasting two days (after
seventeen days),*. — Fine stiulu s and a feeling of tension in the nape of
the neck, on motion (second <iay),*. — Sharp stitches in the back, extending
to the pit of the stomach, at 4.30 p.m., while sitting (first day),*. — Tension
in the back, and pinching in the navel, before dinner (sixth day),*. —
Twitching on the left scapula, frequently repeated, in the evening (third
day),*. — Tearing pain in the whole left scapula, so violent that it seemed
as though it would be torn from the body, waking her from sleep; even in
the morning the part was paini'ul to touch; pain relieved by lying on it
(after five days),*. — Sharp stitches beneath both shoulders, during rest and
motion, in the afternoon (second day),*. — [310.] Stitches between the
shoulders while standing, disappearing on motion,*. — Violent stitches on
the next to the last left rib, near the spine, frequently, more violent at
intervals, but never entirely disappearing, worse wldie sitting, so that it
frequently took away her breath, after dinner, lasting till evening (first
day),*. — Pain in the small of the back, during rest and motion, at night,
and in the morning (sixth day),*. — Some painful stitches in the small of
the back, in the afternoon (third day),*. — Painful gnawing in the small of
the back, during rest and motion ( first day ),*. — Pinching in both lumbar
regions, followed by some emission of flatus with relief,*.

EdCtr entities ill General * — A sensation in the whole left arm and
leg, as if they would fall asleep, in the afternoon while sitting (third day),*.
— Heaviness of the hands and feet as if weary, relieved by motion (fourth
day),*.

Tipper Extremities , — Pain as from a sprain, in the left shoulder,
on motion, relieved by more violent motion, in the morning on waking
(ninth dav),*. — Pain in the left shoulder-joint as if dislocated ; she was

ing even after rising, and only disappearing after violent motion (eighth
(Jay),*, — [320.] Tearing in the right shoulder, on raising the arm, in the

so violent that she was almost in despair, disappearing after rubbing

Stitches on the outer surface of the right knee, while standing/.— ^me

— ^Trembling of the hands and feet (fourth day),*. — [370.] Stitches

Eruption on the nose and lips for three days,* — ^Two red [Hm-

Itching on various parts of the body, in the afternoon (tenth day),*. — Pitch-

quainted, but whom she took for the devil, but afterward recognized, ar

Dream that he ran after men, bruised and very much injured himself (first

Dream that she had quarrelled with an acquaintance (sixth night),*. —
Dream of quarrelling and struggling with her husband, who lived at a dis-
